findings.title: Exiting the demo leaks demo data into the real product: after demo exit + signup/login, the real dashboard renders demo vacancies
findings.evidence: _, True -> case is_public_route(route) { True -> handle_browser_change(Model(..model, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None, auth: NotAsked), uri, route)  // vacancies/dashboard_stats/notifications NOT cleared; then: routes.Dashboard, NotAsked -> fetch  // vacancies is Success(demo) -> gate skips, dashboard renders demo vacancies
findings.detail: Both demo exits (public-route nav, logout) clear only demo_mode/store/auth. vacancies stays Success(demo data); the Dashboard refetch gates on NotAsked, so after signup/login the real landlord sees v-maples/v-harbour until a hard reload. Breaks the demo's own conversion path.
findings.recommended_fix: On demo exit, reset all RemoteData caches (vacancies, dashboard_stats, notifications, detail/leaderboard/comparison/archived) to NotAsked.

findings.detail: Boot on a demo deep link (shared URLs are a core demo entry) leaves vacancies permanently Loading; the in-SPA Dashboard nav only refetches on NotAsked. The demo's most basic navigation breaks.

findings.title: add_days_iso performs a single month rollover - larger validity_days produce invalid closes_at dates
findings.evidence: let new_d = d + days; let new_m = case new_d > total { True -> m + 1 ... }; let new_d2 = case new_d > total { True -> new_d - total ... }  // one rollover only: Aug 19 + 45 -> 2026-09-33
findings.detail: A validity_days of ~43+ yields impossible dates like 2026-09-33 in closes_at (currently masked by the days_remaining bug, but the same function feeds any future closes_at consumer).
findings.recommended_fix: Loop the rollover (or compute via day-of-year arithmetic).

findings.title: pdf_prebake still exits 0 when PDFs fail to bake and swallows mkdir errors (r1 #20 half-landed)

findings.detail: The env-override half landed (RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR), but scripted regeneration still cannot detect failed bakes, and a directory-creation failure is silently ignored.
